messages:
Anna L: Heads-up — bringing up nebula-xl (int4) on the new canary and seeing funcall outputs with trailing garbage after the JSON. Parser failures spiked in the canary run.
Miguel R: ugh. any quick sample output?
Anna L: pasted snippet from a failing response:
```
{"action":"call_tool","tool":"get_price","args":{"ticker":"ACME"}}

��garbled text here>>>
```
That trailing NUL + ascii really confuses the strict parser and our rescue heuristics.
Sasha T: @Anna L thanks. That pattern smells like kvcache/stream-suffix overlap — when the kv cache gets prefixed back into the stream boundary we sometimes see control chars stitched after eos. Did you reproduce with streaming=false?
Anna L: streaming=false drops the failure rate from ~2.7% -> 0.6% but throughput is ~30% lower. So it's definitely tied to streaming + kvcache path.
canary-bot: canary run nebula-xl-int4-2026-03-22: parse_fail_rate=2.71%, baseline (nebula-xl-int8)=0.12%, errors clustered at token positions ~512-548.
Miguel R: ok. hypothesis: int4 kernel changes output tokenization around eos, combined with kvprefix trimming heuristics. Quick mitigation: postprocess rescue that strips trailing control chars and attempts ndjson-repair before failing. low-risk change.
devex-bot: snippet for simple ndjson strip (for quick patch):
```
resp = resp.rstrip('\\x00\\n\\r ')
if not resp.strip().endswith('}'): resp = resp + '\\n"}]'  # naive filler for heuristic rescue
```
Sasha T: Agreed on temporary rescue but we should run a mirror: replicate production traffic -> nebula-xl-int4 with kvcache toggled. Miguel can you kick a 50k-call mirror? Also add a variant with kv_cache_size=0 to confirm.
Miguel R: starting mirror now: nebula-xl-int4/mirror/50k (kvcache=on) and nebula-xl-int4/mirror/50k-kvoff. Will report in ~2h.
Anna L: I'll roll the parser-rescue patch into the canary parser agent and enable additional logging around controlchar tokens.
Sasha T: If mirror confirms kvcache interaction, plan: (1) short-term: parser-rescue + conservative fallback to int8 for toolcall paths; (2) mid-term: adjust kvprefix trimming window to avoid streaming boundary overlap; (3) long-term: add canary flag that forces tokenizer-alignment tests on quantized kernels.
Miguel R: noted. also will add a slice in telemetry for "trailing_controlchar" to surface in the optimize dashboard.
Anna L: ack. action items: Miguel -> mirror + telemetry slice, Sasha -> kvprefix experiment plan, Anna -> parser-rescue + extra logging.
Miguel R: will update thread when mirror results are in. :thumbsup:
Sasha T: thanks all. :face_with_monocle:
